WESTHEAD GATES — brochure site mockup
Direction: Forged (charcoal #0e1114 + brass #c8a24a)
Type: Sora (headings) / Instrument Sans (body)

Everything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a placeholder for real business detail — phone, email, area, address, years, prices, reviews. Send me those and I'll drop them in.

Photo placeholders are the striped gate panels.

SAFETY & COMPLIANCE section added — the standard numbers come from the source documents you sent, but the descriptions are bracketed because those documents could not be opened from this session. Confirm each before it goes live.

GALLERY — the auto-loading bit
No hard-coded image list. A small script on the Plesk server reads /images/ and builds this grid at page load.

Drop a JPEG in the folder → it appears. Delete it → it's gone. Filename becomes the caption and the category chip.

CONTACT
Form posts to a PHP handler on the same server and emails you — no third-party form service, nothing to pay for.

The FAQ answers are the highest-value copy on the site. A real price range in Q1 filters enquiries hard.
MOBILE — same pages, single column, tap targets ≥ 44px. Gallery drops to one column; filters scroll sideways.
